sea anemones text index | photo index Phylum Cnidaria

Class Anthozoa > Subclass Zoantharia/Hexacorallia Order Actiniaria Polka dot anemone
Awaiting identification*updated Nov 2019

Where seen? This small anemone with large polka dots on its body column is sometimes seen in seagrass meadows.

Features: Diameter 3-4cm with tentacles expanded. Many tentacles, tapering translucent with tiny white spots. Body column short translucent with large white edged circular spots. Broad foot which it uses to cling onto seagrass blades.


Changi, Jun 08


Changi, Jul 12

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
